name: dwg-viewer
description: Free and open-source DWG viewer for VS Code

scripts.check: pnpm run check:adapter-package && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter @dwg-viewer/webview check && pnpm --filter dwg-viewer-vscode check
scripts.test: pnpm run check:adapter-package && cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter @dwg-viewer/webview test && pnpm --filter dwg-viewer-vscode test
